# nasc - Network-Aware Synthetic Control R Package

<!-- badges: start -->

<!-- badges: end -->

## Introduction

The `nasc` R-package implements the **Network-Aware Synthetic Control (NASC)** estimator introduced by von Waldow (2026) that implements contamination regularization and bias correction under STUVA violations. The package augments the `bsynth` package (Martinez and Vives-i-Bastida 2025) and implements parts of the `Synth` package (Hainmueller 2026).

## Installation

The current version of `nasc` can be installed from [GitHub](https://github.com/) with:

``` r
pak::pkg_install("fvwaldow/nasc")
```

As the package compiles Stan models, [**Rtools**](https://cran.r-project.org/bin/windows/Rtools/) and [**RStan**](https://mc-stan.org/rstan/) are needed. The `nasc` package was built under R 4.4.2.

## Quick Start

``` r
library(nasc)

# View basic package information
packageDescription("nasc")

# List all functions in the package
ls("package:nasc")
```

A minimal workflow

``` r
library(nasc)

# `panel`        long-format panel data with columns: id, year, y, treated
# `W`            row-standardized spatial-weights matrix (units x units)
# `panel_covs`   long-format covariates with columns: id, year, x1, x2, ...

mod <- nascSynth$new(
  data            = panel,
  time            = year,
  id              = id,
  treated         = treated,
  outcome         = y,
  W               = W,
  spatial_model   = "SAR",
  bias_correction = TRUE,
  nasc_penalty    = TRUE,
  ci_width        = 0.95,

  # Module 2
  covariates            = panel_covs,
  predictors.op         = "mean",
  time.predictors.prior = 1995:1999,            # pre-treatment window
  special.predictors    = list(
    list("y", c(1992, 1995, 1998), "mean"),     # lagged-outcome matching rows
    list("x1", 1999, "mean")
  ),
  # Importance weights V
  predictor_weights = c(0.8, 0.1, 1, 1),

  # Module 1
  rho.covariates  = c("x1", "x2"),              # estimate rho from these covariates only
  rho.time.window = 1996:1999                   # pre-treatment window
)

mod$fit(cores = 12, n_samples = "auto")

mod$summary(ci_width = 0.90)     # ATT, per-period TE, weights, diagnostics
mod$indirectEffect()             # posterior draws/summaries of the spillover effect
mod$updateWidth(0.90)            # re-summarise at a new CI width without re-running MCMC

mod$syntheticPlot()              # observed vs. synthetic outcome path
mod$effectPlot()                 # per-period direct and indirect TE with CrI
mod$attPlot()                    # ATT density 
mod$tauPlot()                    # per-period TE posteriors
mod$posteriorPlot()              # rho, beta, lambda, sigma, bias_correction, ...
mod$weightDraws()                # donor weight posteriors
mod$weightCorr()                 # donor weight correlation

contaminationGraph(mod)          # network graph colored by contamination value
effectGraph(mod)                 # network graph colored by indirect effect
```

## Usage

### Core functions

| Function | Purpose |
|------------------------------------|------------------------------------|
| `nascSynth$new(...)` | Constructs an estimator; picks the Stan model from `spatial_model`, `bias_correction`, `nasc_penalty` |
| `mod$fit(...)` | Runs the (optional) Module 1 spatial model and the Module 2 synthetic-control model via MCMC |
| `mod$summary(ci_width, print)` | Posterior summary: ATT, per-period direct and indirect TE, donor weights, parameters, MCMC diagnostic |
| `mod$indirectEffect()` | Posterior draws and summaries of the indirect effect at the per-period and per-donor level |
| `mod$lambdaCV()` | Selected penalty strength and CV summary |
| `mod$updateWidth(ci_width)` | Recomputes credible intervals without re-running MCMC |
| `mod$plotData` | Tibble of observed and counterfactual outcomes with CrI bounds |

#### `nascSynth$new()` arguments

| Argument | Description |
|------------------------------------|------------------------------------|
| `data`, `time`, `id`, `treated`, `outcome` | Long-format panel |
| `ci_width` | Width of the credible interval |
| `covariates` | Long-format covariate panel |
| `W` | Row-standardized spatial-weights matrix (required when `bias_correction = TRUE` or `nasc_penalty = TRUE`) |
| `spatial_model` | `"none"`, `"SAR"`, `"SDM"`, `"exogenous"`. |
| `rho` | Pre-specified autoregressive parameter (required when `spatial_model = "exogenous"`) |
| `bias_correction` | `TRUE`,`FALSE` |
| `nasc_penalty` | `TRUE`,`FALSE` |
| `predictor_weights` | Importance weights vector (regular covariates, then `special.predictors`) |
| `predictors.op` | Operator (see match.fun()) aggregating each regular predictor over the pre-period (mirrors `predictors.op` from **Synth** package) |
| `special.predictors` | `list(<predictor>, <periods>, <operator>)` (mirrors `predictors.op` from **Synth** package) |
| `time.predictors.prior` | Pre-periods over which regular predictors are aggregated, default `NULL` = all (mirrors `time.predictors.prior` in the **Synth** package) |
| `rho.covariates` | Covariate columns entering Module 1, default `NULL` = all |
| `rho.time.window` | Pre-periods for Module 1, default `NULL` = all |
| `lambda` | Fixed penalty strength, default `NULL` selects lambda by hold-out CV |
| `lambda_cv_grid` | Candidate lambda grid vector for CV |
| `lambda_train_frac` | Share of pre-period for CV training |

#### `fit()` arguments

| Argument | Description |
|------------------------------------|------------------------------------|
| `n_samples` | Rho posterior draws for Module 2, default = `100`, `"auto"` slecets ESS |
| `n_samples_cap` | Upper bound for `n_samples = "auto"` |
| `n_samples_min` | Lower bound for `n_samples = "auto"` |
| `cores` | Number of CPU cores for parallel execution, default = `detectCores() - 1` |
| `worker_iter` | Iterations per worker chain in Module 2 |
| `worker_warmup` | Warmup per worker chain |

### Plot functions

| Function | Output |
|------------------------------------|------------------------------------|
| `mod$syntheticPlot()` | Observed vs. synthetic outcome path with CrI band |
| `mod$effectPlot()` | Direct and indirect TE over time with CrI band |
| `mod$attPlot()` | Posterior density of the ATT |
| `mod$tauPlot()` | Posterior densities of period-by-period TE |
| `mod$posteriorPlot()` | Posterior densities of the estimated parameters |
| `mod$weightDraws()` | Posterioir densities of donor weights |
| `mod$weightCorr()` | Heatmap of correlations between donor weights |
| `contaminationGraph()` | Weights graph with donors colored by posterior-mean contamination (requires `igraph`) |
| `effectGraph()` | Weights graph with donors colored by posterior-mean indirect TE (requires `igraph`) |
| `nascPlot()` | Overlays the synthetic and direct TE plots of list of fitted `nascSynth` objects |
| `nascWeight()` | Multi-model posterioir densities of donor weights of list of fitted `nascSynth` objects |

## Citation

von Waldow, F. (2026). *Network-Aware Synthetic Control - Bias Correction and Regularization under Interference.* Master Thesis.
